item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan gtso yis/ ye gshen seng bzhi la gnang / des snang ba mdog can la gnang / des ye shes snying po la bshad/ des mi lus bsam legs la bshad/ des stong rgyung mthu chen la byin gyis rlabs/ des sha ri dbu chen la byin gyis rlabs/ des gyim tsha rma chung la byin gyis rlabs/ des lce tsha mkhar bu la byin gyis rlabs/ des mkha' 'gro shes rab blo 'phel nas/ dbra btsun shes rab dgongs rgyal la/ rgyal ba zhes pa'i lo'i dri zhim ldan pa dbyar rnga zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i rgyal phur 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ci lta bzhin bris/ rang 'dra dug lngas gtum pa'i lhag chad nor 'khrul sogs/ nyes 'gal ci mchis skyabs yul rnams la bshags/ dge rtsa gang byung mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo//
